title: Water at a Tipping Point How Smart Management Fuels a Thriving Economy
summary: Christophe Beck, Chairman & CEO at Ecolab, shares his thoughts on the essential role smart water management needs to play in the global economy and how Ecolab can help create a profitable and water-secure future for generations to come.
body_text: Water at a Tipping Point: How Smart Management Fuels a Thriving Economy By Christophe Beck 01/28/2025 Photo credit: The World Economic Forum I was encouraged to see water taking center stage at the World Economic Forum Annual Meeting in Davos this year. For perhaps the first time, water was a vital component of discussions about what will ultimately shape our planet's future and global economy. It was a pleasure to join my fellow panelists in the flagship session, 'Water at a Tipping Point,' where we explored both the challenges and opportunities of managing the world's most essential resource: water. Water is not a resource we can create more of. Instead, we must shift our focus towards reusing and optimizing the limited amounts we already have. Projections indicate a staggering 56% gap in water supply and demand by 2030, well before considering the demands imposed by rapid advancements in AI. To put this into perspective, the world's total water supply fits within an 860-mile-wide bubble (1,400 km), and less than 1% of that is usable fresh water, which would fit into a mere 35-mile bubble (56 km). We face a real challenge ahead! Moreover, the anticipated water requirements associated with growing demands for AI and digital solutions add another layer to this dire situation. The market for AI is projected to surge from $85 billion in 2022 to $1.5 trillion in 2040. This growth will necessitate additional power supply equivalent to that of the annual needs of India while requiring enough water to meet the annual drinking needs of the entire United States. Fortunately, there are existing solutions we can leverage. In fact, Ecolab has the technology to help businesses produce more across their operations with less water while reducing costs across multiple industries. The key lies in adopting and transitioning to innovative water circularity solutions. Here is where I recommend we start: Recognize water as an enabler: AI is transforming industries, but it requires substantial water resources, a challenge in water-scarce regions. Data centers are moving to optimize water availability, highlighting this shift in priority. Redesign our processes: The idea of 'wastewater' is an engineering flaw. By reengineering how we use water, we can eliminate wastewater altogether and ensure that every drop is utilized effectively. Establish country-wide water plans and partnerships: We need new frameworks, policies and investments. More than $436 billion in identified opportunities in water-related projects await us, but it requires collaboration between business and government to unlock this potential. The connection between water use, energy output and our economy is critical. Up to 75% of energy consumption is associated with managing water-treating, transporting, heating, and cooling it. By managing our water in a circular construct, we can create meaningful savings in energy and costs while enhancing our carbon footprint. Ultimately, the conversation around water management is not solely about ethics or environmental stewardship-it's about economics and sustainable growth. At Ecolab, we look forward to working together across industries and governments to unlock new growth opportunities and ensure a water-secure future for generations to come. About the Author Christophe Beck President and Chief Executive Officer Christophe Beck is chairman and chief executive officer of Ecolab. He was named Ecolab’s president and chief executive officer in January 2021, and chairman in May 2022. Since joining Ecolab in 2007, he has held several senior leadership roles, including president and chief operating officer; executive vice president and president, Global Industrial Group; executive vice president and president of Nalco Water, an Ecolab company; and executive vice president and president, International Regions. title: Understanding Volume Profile: A Powerful Tool for Traders
summary: How the Volume Profile plots traded volume at each price level, and how traders use its nodes to spot support, resistance, and fair value.
body_text: Volume is one of the most critical elements when analysing a stock’s price chart. Traditionally, traders analyse volume with respect to time. However, what if you could analyse volume with respect to price instead? This perspective unlocks a new layer of understanding in trading. Enter the Volume Profile —a versatile tool that gives traders insights into price levels with significant trading activity. In this article, we dive deep into understanding, using, and applying volume profile in trading. What Is Volume Profile? Volume Profile is a charting tool that plots trading volume against price rather than time. By doing so, traders can identify crucial price levels where significant activity has occurred . These levels often serve as strong support and resistance zones. Unlike traditional volume indicators, Volume Profile highlights areas of high liquidity where the price tends to gravitate and zones of low liquidity where the price can move rapidly. Let's Look at an Example: Consider Raju, an onion wholesaler. Raju deals with highly volatile onion prices daily. He wants to know at what prices he sells the maximum and minimum quantities. By visualising onion prices and quantities sold on a chart, he discovers the most significant price levels. Similarly, traders can use Volume Profile to identify the most traded price levels for a stock, helping them understand key support and resistance zones . Key Components of Volume Profile 1. Point of Control (POC): The price level where the highest volume of trades occurred. This level often acts as a pivot point for price action. 2. High-Volume Zones: Zones with significant trading activity. These areas create a “gravitational pull,” slowing down price movement. 3. Low-Volume Zones: Zones with minimal trading activity. Prices can move quickly through these areas due to low liquidity. 4. Fair Value: The range where 70% of all trades occur. Prices often oscillate within this range, creating a balance zone. Volume Profile provides actionable insights by uncovering patterns hidden within price and volume data. Next, let's discuss how traders can interpret various scenarios. Candlestick Analysis with Volume Profile 1. Bullish Candle: If the price closes above the fair value zone, the candle is bullish. Buyers demonstrate strength by breaking out of high-liquidity areas, suggesting upward momentum. For example, if a green candle closes above its POC, the POC may act as a strong support level in subsequent sessions. 2. Bearish Candle: A red candle closing below the fair value zone indicates bearish sentiment. Sellers overpower buyers, pulling the price down. In this case, the fair value acts as a resistance zone. 3. Neutral Candle: When the price closes near the fair value, the candlestick is neutral, signalling indecision. Analysing multiple candles in such cases is essential to identify the prevailing trend. 4. Trend Reversal Candles: In some cases, the price moves strongly during the day but gets trapped in the fair value zone by the close. For instance: (i) Bullish to Neutral Reversal: Price rises quickly in a low-liquidity zone but closes in the fair value range. (ii) Bearish to Neutral Reversal: Price falls rapidly through low liquidity but closes in the fair value range. These scenarios indicate potential reversals for the next trading session. Intraday and Swing Trading with Volume Profile Intraday Traders: Analysing the previous day’s Volume Profile helps anticipate trends for the next session. Key levels like POC and high-volume nodes provide critical zones for support and resistance. Swing Traders: Longer-term trends can be identified by studying the Volume Profile over a week or month. Consolidation patterns and high-volume zones help traders understand upcoming support and resistance levels. Step-by-Step Guide to Using Volume Profile 1. Open Your Charting Platform: On platforms like TradingView, navigate to the “Forecasting and Measurement Tools” section. 2. Select Fixed Range Volume Profile: This tool is ideal for analysing volume over two fixed price ranges. 3. Plot the Volume Profile: For instance, when analysing Cochin Shipyard stock, you can plot the day’s Volume Profile to identify key levels. 4. Adjust the Fair Value Range: By default, 70% of trades are highlighted. Reducing this to 35% narrows the focus, enabling better insights into key zones. 5. Analyse the Data: Use the plotted profile to identify the day’s fair value, POC, and high/low-volume zones. Example: Suppose Cochin Shipyard’s stock forms a red daily candle and closes inside its fair value zone. This indicates a potential reversal, as sellers couldn’t sustain their momentum. The next day’s trend might see the price bounce upward from this fair value zone. (Volume Profile in action in TradingView) Why Volume Profile is Essential 1. Enhanced Market Understanding: By analysing volume at price levels, traders gain a clearer picture of market dynamics. 2. Improved Accuracy: The tool helps pinpoint high-probability support and resistance zones. 3. Combination with Other Tools: Volume Profile complements other technical analysis techniques, enhancing their effectiveness. Conclusion Mastering the Volume Profile can significantly improve your trading strategy. By understanding volume in relation to price rather than time, you unlock new dimensions of analysis. Whether you are an intraday trader or a swing trader, incorporating this tool into your arsenal will increase your trading success rate. So why wait? Start exploring Volume Profile today and take your trading skills to the next level!

title: 8 Effective Face Yoga Exercises to Reduce Marionette Lines Naturally
summary: Discover 8 powerful face yoga exercises to reduce marionette lines naturally. Lift, tone, and firm your skin with these easy facial exercises.
body_text: We cannot put a full stop to ageing - be it skin ageing, eye bags , or otherwise. However, the question is, can we reverse how age makes us look? Precisely, this is what we will be doing today - erasing off one of the wrinkles you get as you age, the marionette lines. Before we take you through facial exercises and face yoga for marionette lines, let us help you understand these lines. Wait! Have you heard of the phrase, ‘ The face is the mirror of the heart’? Well, you must have. However, at Nirva, the experts always say, ‘the face is the mirror of the gut’ . Confused? Don't be. Before learning the best face yoga techniques, it is wise to look at how good your gut health is. This is because what you eat reflects on your whole body, especially your skin. If you think you need to take a step to cleanse your gut and get glowing skin . Let us know what is troubling you. Find out the causes of your Marionette Lines. Jump to section What are Marionette Lines? Marionette Lines vs Nasolabial Folds What Causes Marionette Lines? Does Sleeping Position Affect Marionette Lines? Face Yoga for Marionette Lines: 8 Powerful Exercises Preparation Before the Exercises Daily Face Yoga Routine to Smooth Marionette Lines The Key Takeaways What are Marionette Lines? Marionette lines, or vertical wrinkles, form between the mouth and chin beside your lips. You can also call them smiling or laughing lines. Let's help you get rid of these depressing lines with the help of the best facial exercises for lines around the mouth. Marionette Lines vs Nasolabial Folds Ever wondered what sets marionette lines apart from nasolabial folds? Both of them are facial wrinkles that appear with age, but marionette lines run from the corners of your mouth to your chin, while nasolabial folds extend from the sides of your nose to the corners of your mouth. “Wrinkles should merely indicate where smiles have been.” - Mark Twain. Nasolabial folds deepen with laughter, while the appearance of marionette lines is mainly caused by natural ageing, resulting in loss of skin elasticity and collagen, which can create a puppet-like appearance. Marionette lines become more prominent with ageing and due to gravity, while nasolabial folds are more noticeable over time in people with expressive facial movements. What Causes Marionette Lines? Marionette lines or melomental folds are often seen in people as they age. However, some might be more prone to these creases or might have more visible, deeper lines, and can contribute to a downturned mouth, giving them a sad or exhausted look. The factors that contribute to the development of marionette lines are: Natural Ageing Process: As you age, your skin produces less collagen, which leads to a loss of elasticity and firmness. Effect of Gravity: The effects of gravity on your skin become visible over time. The downward pull on your skin leads to sagging, especially around your lower face. Repetitive Facial Expressions: Continuously pursing your lips, frowning, or other expressions you make out of habit can gradually lead to marionette lines. Genetics: Some people may develop marionette lines earlier because of genetic factors. If your parents or grandparents have marionette lines, you are likely to have them, too, over time. Lifestyle Factors: Factors like smoking, exposure to sun rays, a poor diet which lacks essential nutrients, and dehydration can cause damage to your skin and accelerate skin ageing, making it sag faster and form wrinkles, including marionette lines. Stress and Poor Sleep: Too much stress and inadequate sleep can also accelerate ageing and cause skin sagging. Does Sleeping Position Affect Marionette Lines? Yes, your sleeping position may create marionette lines over time. Positions that create more constant pressure and friction, such as sleeping on your side or on the stomach, cause repeated creasing of the skin. Eventually, constant pressure can weaken skin elasticity and cause these wrinkles to be more prominent. How do you stop this? Sleeping on your back does not create pressure on the face. Sleeping in this position can avoid the early appearance of marionette lines. Face Yoga for Marionette Lines: 8 Powerful Exercises Relax and calmly learn how to perform each step of these unique face yoga exercises with us. O-Shape-Exercise ‘O’ shape exercise will tighten the muscles around your lips. Moreover, it acts as an excellent exercise for lip wrinkles too. How to Perform? Make an O shape with your mouth. With your index fingers, tap both sides of your mouth. Move the fingers from your lips to your cheeks (in the upward direction.) Practise the same movement for five minutes. Smile Lifter A smile lifter will naturally lift the corners of your mouth and tone the cheek muscles. It is one of the core face yoga exercises for marionette lines. What Should You Do? Move your jaw forward. Curl your lips over your teeth. Smile and keep the corners of your lips at the same level. Lift your chin and try to touch your tongue to the roof of your mouth. Hold the position for 10 seconds. Repeat the same a few times. Cheek Lifter The face yoga technique of the cheek lifter will help pull up muscles responsible for the depressing marionette lines. Toning these muscles helps you erase your marionette lines. How Can You Perform? Cover your cheeks with your palms. With all four fingers, push on the side of your lips. Curl your lips inwards over your teeth. Lift your cheeks as you smile. Inhale and keep in position for 5-10 seconds. Repeat this five times. Pencil Technique The said face yoga technique engages the muscles around your lips, chin, and neck, helping them become more toned and flexible. If you have smoker lines , you should practise this technique of face yoga for smoker lines. How to Perform? Purse your lips to hold the pencil between. Now, try to move your jaw forward and backwards. Tilt your face upwards to the left. Hold for 5 seconds. Now, turn to the right and hold for 5 seconds. Repeat three times. Puffy Cheeks The puffy cheeks facial yoga exercise lifts and fends your cheeks by stimulating circulation. Further, you're in for a bonus. It will definitely help with all the pesky wrinkles around your mouth. What Should You Do? Fill your mouth with air and puff your cheeks. Place one of your palms on your lips. Tap your puffed cheeks gently with the fingertips of your other hand. Carry the process out for both your cheeks for 30 seconds each. Tongue Stretch Tongue stretch is a tension stretch you feel around your mouth when the muscles work well. So, the tension around the mouth gets reduced. It works as a great facial exercise for jowls and facial lines. What Should You Do? Extend your tongue outside like a lion as far as possible. In other words, you should touch your chin with your tongue. Hold in the position for 10 seconds. You can feel the stretch around your mouth. Repeat this for at least five times. Jawline Definer Along with working on marionette lines, jawline definer helps you define your jawline. What are the Steps to Perform? Tilt your head backwards and lift your chin. Close your mouth and move your jaw forward. Hold for 5 seconds. Come back to the starting position. Repeat this movement ten times. The 'L' Shape and Lift Practising the' L' shape and lift face yoga exercises encourages your lips to go upwards instead of downwards. Thus, it makes them one of the best facial exercises for marionette lines. After all, strengthening the muscles between your lips and chin can also help tone your lower jaw. How Can You Perform Them? Make an L shape with your thumb and fingers of both hands at a 90-degree angle to each other on your face. How? The answer is by placing the fingers on each of your cheeks and the thumbs on your chin, touching each other. Pull the cheeks a little backwards without much pressure. Press your lips against each other as you do the above step. Hold this for 15 seconds. Relax and repeat at least five times. You can strengthen all the muscles causing marionette lines by doing all the above exercises. Doing so can beautify your smile naturally. Preparation Before the Exercises Sit in a comfortable place and relax. It's best if you keep the environment around you calm. Take a few deep breaths and release tension. Massage gently using your two fingers on your chin, cheeks and temples for 5 seconds each. Relax and retake a few deep breaths. Daily Face Yoga Routine to Smooth Marionette Lines Let us give you an idea about how to practise these face yoga exercises daily. Here you go! Morning Smile with Morning Sunshine Cleanse with a hydrating cleanser. Wake your muscles up with an easy face yoga routine. What could this easy-peasy routine be? Add cheek puffs, smile lifter and cheek lift. Apply a natural toner that can balance your skin's pH. Apply a natural face serum rich in antioxidants. In the end, apply a good sunscreen with an SPF of 50. P.S. Always use skincare products that suit your skin type. If you're trying on a new one, ensure you do a patch test on your inner elbow. “The most natural way of practising face yoga is by adding ayurvedic essential oils. Try adding face yoga ayurvedic oils like kumkumadi oil for the added benefit of nourishment and relaxation,” -Dr Khusboo Jain, Senior Yoga Coach at Nirva. Ready to Lift, Tone, and Glow? Start the FREE 7-Day Face Yoga Challenge Now! Mid-Day Smile Lifter Hydrate your skin once in a while between your daily chores. Use a good facial mist that contains rose water or chamomile for a refreshing twist. Do some 'O' shape facial yoga exercises. Evening Routine Cleanse and remove your makeup. Detoxify your skin of the impurities of the day. Practise face yoga for marionette lines, wrinkles, sagging skin, and other skin care concerns. Doing so will also help you release muscle tension. Apply a natural toner to relax your skin and replenish it. Before Bed Relaxation Do face massage with a natural face oil or serum before sleeping. Doing so will help you enhance blood circulation and lymphatic drainage. It is essential to relax your body into sleep. You can perform gentle breathwork exercises before you hit the sheets. Further, hydrate yourself with a glass of water. Lastly, sleep on your back to minimise face wrinkles and creases caused by pillow pressure. The Key Takeaways The face yoga exercises for marionette lines l isted above can help strengthen the facial muscles. Yes, where marionette lines often appear, thereby reducing the appearance of such lines and helping to lift your smile naturally. It will be best if you are consistent with this routine. Why? So that your facial muscles work efficiently to make your skin firm. These face yoga exercises for lines around the mouth are simple, non-invasive and worth every effort to practise. title: The Blockchain Bandit Active Again
body_text: Written by: Tushar Tiwari, Analyst at Blockscope Unprecedented Security, Unexpected Vulnerabilities The Ethereum network is widely regarded as one of the most secure blockchain systems, relying on 2²⁵⁶ bits of private keys to safeguard its users. This level of cryptographic protection is designed to be virtually unbreakable. However, despite its formidable security, weaknesses in key generation and implementation have been exploited by one of the most notorious crypto thieves in history, leading to the theft and hoarding of millions in ETH. The Blockchain Bandit On December 30, 2024, the blockchain community watched in shock as the notorious Blockchain Bandit resurfaced, moving 51,000 ETH — worth $185 million — into a multi-signature wallet. This heist, executed primarily by exploiting weak private keys, serves as a sobering reminder of vulnerabilities in blockchain systems. The Discovery of Weak Private Keys In 2018, a report by Independent Security Evaluators (ISE) revealed a shocking vulnerability. Through a process called Ethercombing , researchers uncovered 732 weak private keys linked to wallets on the Ethereum blockchain. Weaknesses stemmed from faulty cryptographic libraries, poor random number generation, and user-generated patterns. These vulnerabilities were exploited by a hacker who is infamously known as the Blockchain Bandit , who amassed nearly 45,000 ETH across 49,060 transactions between 2016–18. This programmatic theft, involving automated brute-force attacks and identification of flawed keys, demonstrates that practical oversights can undermine the theoretical security of Ethereum. The $185 Million Consolidation After two years of dormancy, the Blockchain Bandit consolidated 51,000 ETH from 10 wallets into a single multi-signature address on December 30, 2024. This transfer, executed in batches of 5,000 ETH over 24 minutes, raises questions about the hacker’s motives — whether to secure funds, prepare for liquidation, or signal a larger plan. Currently, the multi-sig wallet being used here “ 0xc45c36017b0b7708f493534ca4f0930964c1d542” is holding around $185M worth of ETH. Blockscope’s Wallet Profiler shows the current holding of the Multi-Sig wallet The stolen Ether had previously remained untouched since January 2023, when it was moved across 10 wallet addresses. This activity coincided with the transfer of 470 Bitcoin on the Bitcoin network, highlighting the scale and precision of the bandit’s operations. Blockscope’s Tracer helped us to visualize and understand how the funds were moved by the Bandit’s Wallet “ 0x957cd4ff9b3894fc78b5134a8dc72b032ffbc464”. Blockscope’s Tracer showing flow of the stolen ETH by Blockchain Bandit While the identity of the Blockchain Bandit remains unknown, the methodical nature of these thefts — dating back to 2016 — underscores the critical importance of secure key generation. What does it mean for Ethereum? The Blockchain Bandit saga serves as a cautionary tale for the crypto world. An actor like it can be a huge threat to the whole ecosystem and a big question mark on the security of the network and participants. An actor holding such a large amount can liquidate the market anytime or try to launder money using mixers like Tornado Cash , which is not good for the ecosystem and Ethereum, particularly. Key Takeaways from the Heist: Weak Key Generation : Vulnerabilities arising from poor cryptographic practices remain a major risk factor. Human Error : Inadequate randomness and user-driven patterns continue to expose wallets to theft. Improbable Isn’t Impossible : Despite Ethereum’s robust 2²⁵⁶ bit security, real-world flaws can still be exploited. Cointelegraph’s report also highlights a broader trend — crypto hacks reached a record $2.3 billion in 2024, with access control breaches accounting for 81% of the stolen value. This includes flaws in centralized exchanges and custodian platforms, emphasizing the need for robust security protocols. The Future of Blockchain Security While Ethereum’s theoretical security remains formidable, the Blockchain Bandit’s exploits reveal a persistent gap between theory and practice. Addressing these vulnerabilities requires ongoing vigilance, rigorous audits, and education for developers and users alike. At Blockscope , we continue investigating and illuminating such vulnerabilities, helping safeguard the decentralized future. The Blockchain Bandit’s story is a stark reminder that security is a shared responsibility in the ever-evolving world of blockchain.

title: Evaluating Potential Over Perfection: Finding the Right Talent
summary: Discover how to identify high-potential candidates by focusing on adaptability, problem-solving, and a growth mindset to drive success.
body_text: This is the second article in our recruitment series , building on the foundation of hiring trailblazers. If you haven’t already, explore the first article to learn why trailblazers are essential for driving innovation and growth. In this piece, we delve into how evaluating potential over perfection can help identify candidates with the potential to transform your organisation. Traditional interviews often focus on experience and surface-level qualifications, leaving little room to uncover a candidate’s true potential. This outdated approach can lead to hiring decisions that reinforce the status quo rather than propel your organisation forward. In today’s dynamic workplace, evaluating potential is far more critical than searching for a “perfect” fit. Building on the idea of hiring trailblazers , this article explores how to identify candidates who bring adaptability, creativity, and a growth mindset to your team. The Problem with Traditional Interviews: Why Evaluating Potential Over Perfection Matters Traditional hiring mistakes can be costly. According to a Harvard Business Review study, 80% of employee turnover stems from bad hiring decisions. Poor assessments not only waste resources but also damage team dynamics and morale. Conventional interviews tend to prioritise predictable, rehearsed answers and a polished demeanour . While these qualities may indicate preparation, they don’t necessarily reveal a candidate’s ability to adapt, learn, or solve complex problems. Furthermore, traditional methods often favour candidates who fit predefined moulds, resulting in "safe" hires that stagnate innovation . Another common issue is overvaluing cultural or job fit at the expense of diversity and fresh perspectives. Instead of discovering candidates who challenge assumptions and bring new ideas, organisations risk hiring individuals who simply reinforce existing practices. What to Look for in Candidates To identify high-potential candidates, shift the focus from credentials to traits that signal long-term value. Here’s what to prioritise: Adaptability : Does the candidate thrive in changing environments? Do they embrace learning new skills? Problem-Solving Ability : How do they approach challenges? Are they proactive in finding solutions? Constructive Challenging : Trailblazers often challenge the status quo, but there’s a distinction between constructive criticism and arguing for the sake of being difficult. Look for candidates who challenge ideas with the intent to improve outcomes, not to disrupt for attention. Growth Mindset : Are they open to feedback, committed to continuous improvement, and willing to learn entirely new skills? Techniques to Evaluate Potential Evaluating potential requires a departure from traditional methods. However, some modern approaches, like background checks on social media, raise ethical and practical questions. Candidates might use pseudonyms, keep accounts private, or feel such scrutiny invades their privacy. Instead, focus on structured evaluations and transparent techniques. Here are some innovative ways to uncover a candidate’s true abilities and mindset: Behavioural-Based Questions : Ask open-ended questions to explore past experiences that demonstrate adaptability, problem-solving, team-work, and initiative. Example : “Tell me about a time you had to learn something outside your comfort zone to complete a task. How did you approach it?” Real-World Tasks : Assign practical tasks or case studies related to the role. Focus on their thought process and creativity rather than the final result. Example : A marketing candidate could be asked to create a mock campaign for a fictional product. Hypothetical Scenarios : Pose scenarios that encourage creative thinking and problem-solving. Example : “Imagine a key process in your last role was failing. How would you identify the problem and fix it?” Non-Traditional Metrics : Evaluate traits like curiosity, collaboration, and emotional intelligence. These traits often indicate a candidate’s readiness to take on evolving challenges. Unexpected Shifts in Interview Questions : Switching between work and non-work-related questions helps assess a candidate's ability to handle unexpected challenges, adapt quickly, and refocus. Introduce unexpected topics to observe how candidates adapt and think on their feet. Quickly transition back to work topics to test their mental agility. Structured Evaluation Tools : Use tools like BrioHR’s Recruitment Module to reduce biases and ensure a fair assessment process. Data-driven insights can help uncover potential that might be missed during unstructured interviews. Common Pitfalls in Candidate Assessments Even with structured techniques, some common traps can obscure a candidate's true potential. Avoid these pitfalls to ensure fair and accurate assessments. Here are some innovative techniques to help you uncover a candidate’s true abilities and mindset: Relying on Resume Gaps as Indicators : Candidates who leave roles after a year might not always be high performers. In some countries, extended probationary periods are required before termination, and short stints might reflect this rather than job-hopping tendencies. Overemphasising Perfection : Polished answers or a flawless interview performance can mask a lack of adaptability or willingness to grow. This could also result from candidates having faced dozens of interviews with repetitive, predictable questions, honing their ability to present polished but surface-level responses. Misinterpreting Challenging Behaviour : Constructive challengers aim to improve processes or outcomes. Be cautious not to dismiss them as disruptive without understanding their intent. Ignoring Context : Candidates from unconventional backgrounds or industries often bring unique perspectives. Don’t overlook them based on rigid criteria. The idea that someone from a smaller company cannot handle the challenges of a larger organisation is often misguided. In fact, smaller company employees often have broader skill sets due to less specialised roles, unlike their counterparts in larger organisations who may focus on narrower tasks within segmented teams. Next Steps for Smarter Hiring Rethinking recruitment isn’t just about finding good candidates—it’s about driving innovation, fostering a resilient workforce, and ensuring long-term success. By prioritising traits like adaptability, problem-solving, and a growth mindset, you can uncover the potential that conventional interviews often miss. By rethinking traditional assessments, you can build a workforce of trailblazers who will drive innovation and ensure long-term success. title: Marketing for Success: Boost Your Business with Social Media
summary: Learn marketing tips for small businesses and entrepreneurs to boost sales. Use social media, create engaging content, and promote your Take App store effectively.
body_text: As a small business owner or entrepreneur, building your brand and engaging with your audience is essential for growth. Social media is one of the most cost-effective tools at your disposal. Platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok allow you to showcase your products, connect with customers, and drive traffic to your Take App store. In this blog, we’ll explore how to use social media and create engaging content to effectively promote your business. Use Social Media Effectively Social media is an versatile platform that can help you build brand awareness, foster customer loyalty, and drive sales. With the ability to share visuals, videos, and stories, it’s the perfect space to showcase your products, tell your brand’s story, and create meaningful interactions with your audience—all at little to no cost. Here are some practical tips to maximize the impact of your social media presence: **Post Regularly **Consistency is crucial when it comes to social media. The more regularly you post, the more likely your audience will engage with your content. Aim for 3-5 posts per week to keep your brand top of mind without overwhelming your followers. Use tools like Meta Business Suite or other scheduling apps to plan ahead and stay on track. **Use Stories and Reels **Instagram Stories and Reels are good for showcasing authentic, real-time content. Stories allow you to give a quick, unpolished look into your business. Reels, on the other hand, have a wider reach and can be a great tool for showing off more unique aspects of your business. Whether it’s a behind-the-scenes process or a new product launch, Reels allow you to grab your audience's attention with creative, bite-sized content. **Engage With Followers **Don’t just post and ghost. Social media is about building relationships, and one of the best ways to do that is by responding to comments and messages quickly. Whether it’s a simple “thank you” or a more in-depth reply to a question, showing that you value your followers’ input will foster loyalty and increase engagement. **Hashtag Strategy **Hashtags are an effective way to make your posts discoverable by people who might not yet follow you. Use a mix of popular, niche, and location-specific hashtags to reach the right audience. For example, if you run a bakery in Singapore, you might use #homemadebread, #singaporefoodie, and #localbakery. Take time to research which hashtags your competitors use and test them for your own content. Over time, you’ll learn which tags generate the most engagement. **Collaborate **If you have the resources, collaborating with micro-influencers or other local businesses can significantly extend your reach. For example, partner with a food blogger or local influencer to showcase your products in exchange for free samples. These collaborations not only introduce you to new audiences but also add authenticity to your brand. **Use Call-to-Actions (CTAs) **Every post you make should prompt your audience to take action. This can be as simple as a “Click the link in our bio to order” or “Tag a friend who loves this dish!” Effective CTAs drive traffic to your Take App store, increase engagement, and boost conversions. **Run Contests and Giveaways **People love free stuff, and running a well-timed giveaway is an excellent way to engage your audience, expand your reach, and gain new followers. To make it effective, ensure your giveaway is simple and follows the platform’s guidelines. For example, encourage users to like, comment, and tag friends for a chance to win your products. Create Engaging Content Content is the heart of your marketing efforts. Engaging content not only keeps your audience interested, but it also educates them, builds trust, and inspires them to take action. Great content is varied, relevant, and valuable to your audience, making them more likely to share, comment, or engage with your brand. Here are some content strategies that work well for small businesses: **Educational Posts **One of the best ways to engage with your audience is by offering valuable, educational content. Share tips, tutorials, or insights that relate to your products or services. For example, if you sell skincare products, post a video showing how to apply your moisturizer effectively. These types of posts position you as an expert in your industry and help build trust with your audience. Customer Stories Your customers are your best advocates, so why not let them share their experiences? Feature real customer stories on your social media to show how your products have made a positive impact in their lives. Including photos or quotes from customers adds authenticity and trustworthiness to your brand. **Polls and Questions **People love to share their opinions, so engage them by asking questions, running polls, or even creating fun challenges. Asking questions like “Which new flavor should we launch next?” or running a quick poll can drive higher engagement while also gathering valuable feedback from your followers. **Maximize Your Content **Once you’ve created great content, make sure you reuse it across different platforms. Share the same blog post on your Instagram feed, WhatsApp, and your Take App store. This saves you time and ensures your content reaches the widest possible audience. **User-Generated Content **Encourage your customers to share photos or videos of themselves using your product. When they do, feature their content on your social media profiles. This fosters a sense of community, builds trust, and adds authenticity to your brand. At Take App, we care about your success and are here to help you grow your business. By applying these social media and content marketing tips, you can effectively promote your Take App store, connect with customers, and build a loyal community around your brand. Start implementing these strategies today, and watch your business take off!

title: Whistleblower Policy (December 13, 2024)

body_text: Corporate Governance Guidelines Aleanna, Inc. Effective December 13, 2024 PURPOSE The Audit Committee (“Audit Committee”) of the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of AleAnna, Inc. (the “Company”) has adopted the following policy and procedures for: the receipt, retention, and treatment of complaints regarding accounting, internal accounting controls or auditing matters; the confidential, anonymous submission by employees of the Company of concerns regarding questionable accounting or auditing matters; and to alert the Audit Committee to possible problems before they have serious consequences to the Company. POLICY These procedures relate to complaints or concerns regarding accounting, internal accounting controls or auditing matters of the Company (“Complaints”) including, but not limited to, the following: fraud or deliberate error in the preparation, evaluation, review or audit of any financial statement of the Company; fraud or deliberate error in the recording or maintaining of financial records of the Company; deficiencies in or noncompliance with the Company’s internal accounting controls; misrepresentations or false statements to or by a senior officer of the Company or an accountant regarding a matter contained in the financial records, financial reports or audit reports of the Company; and deviation from full and fair reporting of the Company’s financial condition. This policy applies to all employees, independent contractors and consultants, who work for the Company (“Covered Persons”). RESPONSIBILITIES AND RIGHTS OF EMPLOYEE COMPLAINANTS AND INVESTIGATION PARTICIPANTS Responsibilities Covered Persons who submit Complaints (“Employee Complainants”) have a responsibility to act in good faith and have a reasonable belief regarding the validity of a Complaint. The motivation of an Employee Complainant is irrelevant to the consideration of the validity of the Complaint. However, the intentional filing of a false Complaint, whether orally or in writing, may itself be an improper activity and one that may result in disciplinary action. An Employee Complainant has a responsibility to be candid and set forth all known information regarding a Complaint. Covered Persons who are interviewed or asked to provide information or otherwise participate in an investigation of a Complaint, including employees who are the subject of the investigation (“Investigation Participants”) have a duty to cooperate fully and assist in the investigation. Employee Complainants are not to act on their own in conducting any investigative activities, nor do they have a right to participate in any investigative activities other than as requested by the Audit Committee or the Company’s Corporate Counsel. An Employee Complainant shall refrain from obtaining evidence relating to a Complaint for which he or she does not have a right of access. Such improper access may itself be an illegal or improper activity and one that may result in disciplinary action. The Company will use reasonable best efforts to provide each Employee Complainant with a prompt investigation and response to his or her Complaint and a summary of the outcome of any investigation based upon the Complaint unless the Company’s Corporate Counsel or the Audit Committee determines that there are overriding legal, Company or public interest reasons not to do so. These procedures are in no way intended to limit employee reporting of alleged violations relating to accounting or auditing matters to proper governmental and regulatory authorities. Rights Employee Complainants and Investigation Participants are entitled to protection from retaliation for having made a Complaint or disclosing information relating to a Complaint in good faith. The Company shall not discharge, demote, suspend, threaten, harass or in any manner discriminate against an Employee Complainant in the terms and conditions of employment based upon any lawful actions of such Employee Complainant with respect to good faith reporting of Complaints. It is a serious violation of the policies of the Company, and under certain circumstances a violation of federal or local law, for any supervisor, manager, director, or officer of the Company to initiate or encourage reprisal against an employee or other person who in good faith reports a known or suspected violation of criminal law or any other matter which may be reported under this policy. An Employee Complainant’s right to protection from retaliation does not extend immunity for any complicity in the matters that are the subject of the Complaint or an ensuing investigation. To the extent possible and permitted under law, Complaints, reports and investigations related to such Complaints, shall be kept confidential. Disclosure of such Complaints to individuals not connected to the investigation will be viewed as a serious disciplinary offense and may result in discipline, including dismissal. REPORTING PROCEDURES The Company allows submission of Complaints either orally or in writing. Employee Complainants may report Complaints anonymously to: www.RedFlagReporting.com (the client code is “AleAnna”) or call 1-877-647-3335. Alternately, an Employee Complainant may report a Complaint to his or her supervisor, or in the case an Employee Complainant is not comfortable reporting the Complaint to his or her supervisor or believes the supervisor has taken no action, the Company’s Corporate Counsel or the Chair of the Audit Committee. To assist in the response to or investigation of a Complaint, the Complaint should be factual rather than speculative, and contain as much specific information as possible to allow for proper assessment of the nature, extent and urgency of the matter that is the subject of the Complaint. Without limiting the foregoing, the Complaint should, to the extent possible, contain the following information: the alleged event, matter or issue that is the subject of the Complaint; the name of each person involved; if the Complaint involves a specific event or events, the approximate date and location of each event; and any additional information, documentation or other evidence available to support the Complaint. INVESTIGATION PROCEDURE The Company’s Corporate Counsel will collect the information and investigate the matter as appropriate based on the nature of the matter. All Complaints will be promptly evaluated and investigated, although the seriousness and complexity of the concern can affect the time needed to investigate the matter. The Company’s Corporate Counsel shall seek to respond to the Complaint to the satisfaction of the person who made the Complaint. Irrespective of whether he or she is able to resolve the Complaint to the satisfaction of the person making the Complaint, the Company’s Corporate Counsel shall promptly forward a copy of each Complaint to the Audit Committee. The Company’s Corporate Counsel may also, in his or her discretion, bring the Complaint to the attention of the Company’s full Board of Directors, Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer or any other party that the Company’s Corporate Counsel deems necessary or appropriate. This investigation may include hiring outside advisors such as lawyers, accountants and auditors to conduct procedures under the direction of the Audit Committee. The Company will provide appropriate funding, as determined by the Audit Committee to compensate any advisor engaged by the Audit Committee. After completing an investigation of a Complaint, the Company’s Corporate Counsel shall prepare a written report for the Audit Committee explaining his or her conclusions and advice with respect to the Complaint. A copy of the report shall be placed in the Complaint file. The Audit Committee may, in its sole discretion, request a briefing by the Company’s Corporate Counsel. The Audit Committee shall have full authority to determine the action to be taken in response to a Complaint and to direct additional investigation of any Complaint. RETENTION OF COMPLAINTS The Company’s Corporate Counsel shall maintain a file for all Complaints. If the Company’s Corporate Counsel receives an unwritten Complaint, he or she shall memorialize such Complaint in writing and place it in the Complaint file.

title: Maintaining Safety and Security for Mexico Cross-Border Shipments
summary: At Landstar, our commitment to safe, secure transportation goes beyond borders. Landstar EVP of Operations Eric Meyer shares insight on how to protect your Mexico cross-border freight in this blog.
body_text: What should shippers look for in a reliable Mexico cross-border logistics company? Shippers should prioritize logistics companies with a Customs Trade Partnership Against Terrorism ( CTPAT ) certification as it indicates adherence to security best practices outlined by U.S. Customs and Border Protection. A company’s history of damage-free shipments also is crucial, and it should have a robust network of safe drivers on both sides of the border. As a company that prioritizes safety, Landstar has strict qualification requirements for its Business Capacity Owners (BCOs) and only uses cross-border carriers that are CTPAT-compliant. It’s also beneficial to work with a logistics company that offers customs brokerage services. By managing both transportation and customs, a provider gains better visibility into the shipment's progress across the border and can potentially intervene if any issues arise. When customs clearance is conducted by a third party, such as a freight forwarder, it may be more difficult for the logistics provider to maintain visibility throughout. What are the advantages of using a logistics provider with a CTPAT certification? When shippers work with a CTPAT certified provider, they have the reassurance of knowing the provider has an established partnership with U.S. Customs and Border Protection and have committed to operate its business in compliance with the agency’s security requirements . Some of these requirements include having documented processes to identify and address security threats, conducting supply chain risk assessments, and proving ongoing efforts to maintain and improve supply chain security. Does technology enhance the security of goods in transit? Technology plays a large role in the security of cross-border freight and peace of mind to shippers. For instance, advanced tracking technologies like GPS and RFID tags offer continuous visibility of shipments. Heightened visibility enables logistics providers to promptly address unexpected issues for minimal disruption. At Landstar, technology enables shippers to receive real-time alerts via email regarding estimated delivery times, potential delays, and notifications when cargo arrives at the border. Moreover, technology-assisted operations, such as the 17-point CTPAT inspection conducted at Landstar's U.S. – Mexico Logistics Service Center in Laredo adds an additional layer of security. What role do relationships play in cross-border freight security? Strong relationships with customs authorities on both sides of the border are invaluable, as they help logistics companies stay current with regulations and facilitate quick, secure crossings. Additionally, using vetted carrier partners is key to putting freight in capable hands. Landstar has been conducting moves at the U.S. – Mexico border for more than 25 years which has enabled us to forge strong connections with government authorities, trusted carriers and business partners. Does specialized freight require additional security or safety considerations? Shippers with specialized freight should select logistics companies experienced in handling their specific type of cargo, such as hazardous materials, oversize or temperature-sensitive goods. These specialized shipments often require additional planning and knowledge on behalf of the transportation provider. For instance, all carriers moving hazardous materials (hazmat) must be certified and renew their training every 3 years to be in compliance with the United States Department of Transportation (USDOT). Landstar requires that all of our BCOs – our leased owner-operators in the United States and Canada -- are hazmat certified so they can safely move this type of freight. Other specialized shipments like oversize freight require detailed route planning, additional permitting and specialty equipment to remain safe and avoid damage during transport. Keep in mind, this type of freight typically requires extra documentation to clear customs. Shippers can mitigate delays by working with an experienced provider who is knowledgeable in customs requirements for specialized shipments.

title: How Are Surveys and Field Research Similar
summary: Discover the key similarities and differences between surveys and field research, from methodologies to applications. Learn how these traditional research methods can be enhanced by AI tools to gather deeper insights and make better decisions. A practical guide for researchers and business professionals.
body_text: Surveys and Field Research: Complementary Methods United by the Search for Truth Both surveys and field research share a fundamental goal: understanding human behavior, experiences, and perspectives directly from the source. While these methods approach data collection differently, they're both systematic ways of gathering firsthand insights from real people in service of answering research questions. The key difference lies not in their ultimate purpose, but in how they achieve it. Research methods shouldn't be a mystery. Whether you're developing a new product, understanding customer behavior, or conducting academic research, knowing when to use surveys versus field research – or both – can make the difference between surface-level data and genuine insights. ‍ Understanding the Basics: What Sets These Methods Apart Field research puts you directly in the environment where behavior happens. Picture a retail researcher watching customers navigate store aisles, noting their paths and pause points, or an anthropologist living within a community to understand cultural practices. This method excels at capturing the "how" and "why" of human behavior in its natural context. Surveys, on the other hand, provide a structured way to collect thoughts, opinions, and reported behaviors from large groups. They're your go-to tool when you need to understand what people think or say they do across a broad population. Modern survey platforms, like Aftercare , enhance this traditional method by automatically generating relevant questions and adapting to responses in real-time. ‍ Choosing Your Research Method: A Practical Guide Your choice between surveys and field research should align with your research goals. Here's when each method shines: Choose surveys when you need to: Measure specific attitudes or preferences across a large group Track changes in customer satisfaction over time Gather quantifiable data for statistical analysis Collect feedback quickly and at scale Field research becomes invaluable when you need to: Understand complex behaviors in natural settings Uncover unspoken needs or pain points Observe how people actually use products or services Capture rich contextual details that influence behavior ‍ The Power of Combination The most robust research often combines both methods. For example, a product development team might start with field research to observe how people currently solve a problem, then use surveys to validate potential solutions at scale. This approach provides both depth and breadth of understanding. Modern tools make this combination more powerful than ever. AI-powered survey platforms can now adapt their questioning based on responses, mimicking the natural follow-up patterns of field research. For instance, when a customer reports a negative experience, Aftercare automatically generates relevant follow-up questions to dig deeper into the specific circumstances and impact. ‍ Maximizing Data Quality in Both Methods The value of your research depends heavily on data quality. In field research, this means: Maintaining detailed observation notes Being aware of potential observer bias Documenting contextual factors Using structured observation protocols For surveys, quality comes from: Clear, unambiguous questions Appropriate sampling methods Response validation Follow-up mechanisms for clarity Modern technology has transformed how we ensure data quality. AI-powered analysis can now automatically categorize open-ended responses and generate summaries from large datasets, reducing human bias in interpretation while saving valuable analysis time. ‍ The Human Element: Essential in Both Methods Despite technological advances, the human element remains crucial in both research methods. Field researchers need strong observational skills and the ability to build rapport with subjects. Survey researchers must craft questions that resonate with respondents and encourage honest, thoughtful responses. The key is finding the right balance between human insight and technological efficiency. While AI can help generate survey questions and analyze responses, human judgment remains essential for interpreting context and nuance. ‍ From Data to Insights: Analysis Approaches The analysis phase is where many researchers struggle, but it's also where modern tools shine. Field research typically generates rich, qualitative data that requires careful coding and theme identification. Survey data, especially at scale, needs statistical analysis and pattern recognition. AI-powered tools have transformed this process. For instance, when analyzing open-ended survey responses, platforms like Aftercare can automatically: Categorize responses by theme Identify emerging patterns Generate summaries of key findings Suggest follow-up questions for deeper insight ‍ Real-World Applications Let's look at how these methods work together in practice: Retail Experience Improvement: Field research reveals customers struggling to find products in certain store sections Follow-up surveys quantify the issue across locations and gather specific improvement suggestions AI-powered analysis identifies common themes in customer feedback Results lead to targeted store layout improvements Healthcare Service Development: Surveys identify broad patterns in patient satisfaction Field observations in waiting rooms reveal unexpected pain points AI-generated follow-up questions dig deeper into specific issues Combined insights drive meaningful service improvements ‍ Implementation Best Practices Success in research requires careful planning and execution. Consider these key factors: Start with clear research objectives Choose methods that match your goals and resources Use technology to enhance, not replace, human insight Plan for adequate time and resources Build in flexibility for unexpected findings ‍ Looking Forward: The Evolution of Research Methods Research methods continue to evolve with technology. AI-powered tools now help bridge the gap between surveys and field research by enabling more natural, conversational data collection at scale. This evolution doesn't replace traditional methods but enhances them, making robust research more accessible to organizations of all sizes.

title: Por que utilizar análise preditiva na cadeia de suprimentos?
summary: Aprenda a realizar análise preditiva na cadeia de suprimentos em 5 passos, os benefícios + 4 principais desafios da prática e como resolver cada um!
body_text: A análise preditiva na cadeia de suprimentos consiste em usar dados históricos, técnicas, métodos estatísticos e algoritmos para identificar padrões, hábitos e comportamentos que ajudam a prever tendências e eventos com potencial para afetar a rede de abastecimento da empresa. Essa prática ajuda a, por exemplo, antecipar necessidades de abastecimento, definir níveis futuros de estoque, aprimorar a logística e encontrar os melhores fornecedores para cada tipo de demanda. Dessa forma, é possível construir uma supply chain muito mais eficiente, dinâmica, proativa e com alto potencial de adequação rápida às mudanças do mercado. Um dos resultados é o aprimoramento do desempenho geral do negócio, já que a área de compras e procurement é extremamente estratégica e um dos pilares de crescimento e sucesso de qualquer negócio. Porém, para obter vantagens como essas, você deve usar as ferramentas de análise preditiva certas e alinhá-las a uma boa gestão de riscos na cadeia de suprimentos. Como? Siga a leitura e descubra! O que é análise preditiva na cadeia de suprimentos? A análise preditiva na cadeia de suprimentos é uma técnica que utiliza dados históricos como base para a identificação de padrões. O objetivo é se antecipar a diferentes situações e, assim, preparar melhor a empresa para cenários futuros, mitigar riscos e otimizar processos. É possível aplicar essa prática em atividades como: previsão de demandas : mostra quanto comprar de matérias-primas ou quais serviços contratar e quando realizar as aquisições; otimização de estoque : ao mostrar o nível ideal de estocagem a partir da consideração de critérios anteriores como sazonalidade e mudanças de interesse dos clientes finais; logística e transporte : por meio da previsão de tempo de entrega e da geração de informações a que ajudam a montar as melhores rotas, por exemplo; avaliação de risco de fornecedores : devido ao acompanhamento do desempenho desses parceiros comerciais e identificação de mudanças em seus comportamentos, os quais podem gerar problemas para a companhia. Dica de leitura: “ Matriz de risco de fornecedores: como definir e utilizar? ” Quais os benefícios da análise preditiva na gestão de suprimentos? Usar a análise preditiva na gestão de suprimentos traz diversos benefícios. Estes são os que mais se destacam: aumento da eficiência operacional; identificação antecipada de riscos; aprimoramento do controle de estoque ; melhora do relacionamento com os fornecedores; decisões mais precisas (tomadas a partir de dados); redução de gastos operacionais; distribuição mais estratégica dos recursos financeiros. Esses são resultados possíveis porque a análise preditiva na cadeia de suprimentos é uma estratégia proativa. Significa que você não espera o problema surgir ou a mudança acontecer para decidir o que fazer. Justamente a antecipação aos possíveis cenários é o que permite preparar melhor a empresa. Consequentemente, há menos chances de falhas, de escolhas erradas e de perdas financeiras. Por fim, consegue-se definir fluxos operacionais mais precisos, que contribuem para atender melhor os clientes finais e, assim, gerar mais vendas e faturamento. Os 4 principais desafios e como superá-los Todavia, há alguns desafios a superar para realizar uma análise preditiva na cadeia de suprimentos eficaz. Veja os principais e como contorná-los. Qualidade dos dados Você consegue resolver esse problema por meio de processos como higienização da base de dados , que consiste em remover informações duplicadas, desatualizadas, incompletas ou fora do padrão. É possível realizar essa atividade manualmente ou com ajuda de softwares específicos. Integração de sistemas para extrair informações O segredo aqui é usar ferramentas de análise preditiva nativamente integráveis, ou recorrer a recursos que permitem essa prática, a exemplo de APIs — Application Programming Interface — Interface de Programação de Aplicação — mecanismos que viabilizam a comunicação entre softwares Falta de treinamento das equipes para interpretar os números Esse desafio se resolve por meio de investimentos em cursos e capacitações para aprimorar os conhecimentos e habilidades dos profissionais responsáveis pela previsão de demandas de compras. Outra possibilidade é contratar especialistas e terceirizar a análise preditiva na cadeia de suprimentos da sua empresa. Aqui vai uma dica! Antes de efetivar essa contratação, leia o artigo: “ Quais são os riscos de terceirizar serviços da empresa? + 12 dicas para evitá-los ” Custo com contratação de recursos tecnológicos Ferramentas de análise preditiva tendem a ter custos elevados. Por esse motivo, é fundamental avaliar o custo-benefício. Uma forma de superar esse obstáculo é usar os períodos de teste grátis oferecidos por alguns sistemas antes de fechar a contratação. Também é importante comprovar para os tomadores de decisão o valor da ferramenta, não no sentido de preço, mas, sim, dos benefícios da sua implementação para a empresa. 7 desafios da cadeia de suprimentos e como superá-los Como realizar análise preditiva na cadeia de suprimentos? 5 passos! Para realizar análise preditiva na cadeia de suprimentos da sua empresa, você deve: definir os objetivos; escolher um modelo preditivo; determinar as ferramentas; coletar e analisar os dados; mensurar os resultados. Vamos aos detalhes? 1. Defina os objetivos Como comentamos logo na abertura, você pode usar a análise preditiva em diferentes momentos, como no aprimoramento da gestão de riscos na cadeia de suprimentos ou para aumentar a eficiência operacional. Assim, para definir seus objetivos de uso, analise seus processos, reveja os planejamentos estratégicos, metas e avalie quanto a precisão de demandas ajuda a atingir os resultados pretendidos. 2. Escolha um modelo preditivo Os modelos preditivos são técnicas estatísticas de análise de dados históricos. Este são alguns exemplos: regressão linear : auxilia na previsão de valores contínuos, a exemplo de preços cobrados pelos fornecedores; ARIMA (AutoRegressive Integrated Moving Average, ou média móvel integrada autorregressiva, em português) : analisa sequências temporais de dados, como demanda de vendas para definir quanto de matéria-prima comprar; redes neurais : são inspirados no funcionamento do cérebro humano e usados para verificar grandes volumes de dados e identificar padrões complexos. A escolha do modelo preditivo ideal depende do objetivo da sua análise. 3. Determine as ferramentas Existem diversas ferramentas de análise preditiva no mercado, por exemplo, Microsoft Azure Machine Learning e Google Cloud AI . Escolha a melhor para a sua empresa a partir de critérios como custo-benefício, facilidade de uso e camadas de segurança. 4. Colete e analise os dados Para alimentar as ferramentas, extraia dados de diferentes fontes e sistemas utilizados na sua empresa, como ERPs (Enterprise Resource Planning), softwares de compras, de gestão de estoque e SRM (sistema de relacionamento com fornecedores) . Considere também informações obtidas de fontes externas, como dados econômicos e tendências de mercado em sites e plataformas confiáveis. Dica! Assista ao vídeo abaixo, com Leo Cavalcanti, CEO e cofundador da Linkana, e entenda o que é um SRM: 5. Mensure os resultados Por meio de KPIs (indicadores-chave de desempenho) como: Retorno sobre o Investimento (ROI) : mostra se as iniciativas de análise preditiva geraram ou não benefícios financeiros; Valor Preditivo Positivo (VPP) : revela a capacidade de um modelo prever eventos positivos corretamente; custo de ruptura de estoque : potencial gasto decorrente de previsões de demanda erradas; precisão do modelo : mensura o percentual de acertos sobre cenários futuros em relação ao total de situações previstas.
