title: Perplexity AI Makes Waves with New Sonar API for Enterprise AI Search
summary: Perplexity AI has unveiled Sonar, an innovative API service that allows businesses to seamlessly integrate AI search technology into their applications. The Sonar API comes in two tiers: a Standard version that offers a cost-effective solution for basic needs, and Sonar Pro, which provides advanced features, including multi-step query handling and enhanced compliance capabilities. Sonar sets itself apart with real-time web searches and verifiable citations, targeting industries like finance, healthcare, and IT services. This marks a significant move in the AI search market, posing a challenge to established giants like Google and signaling a shift towards more accessible AI technologies for smaller businesses.
body_text: AI Search Innovation Perplexity AI Makes Waves with New Sonar API for Enterprise AI Search Perplexity AI has unveiled Sonar, an innovative API service that allows businesses to seamlessly integrate AI search technology into their applications. The Sonar API comes in two tiers: a Standard version that offers a cost‑effective solution for basic needs, and Sonar Pro, which provides advanced features, including multi‑step query handling and enhanced compliance capabilities. Sonar sets itself apart with real‑time web searches and verifiable citations, targeting industries like finance, healthcare, and IT services. This marks a significant move in the AI search market, posing a challenge to established giants like Google and signaling a shift towards more accessible AI technologies for smaller businesses. Introduction to Perplexity's Sonar API Perplexity 's Sonar API represents a significant step forward in the integration of AI technologies into enterprise settings. By providing businesses with the tools to perform real‑time AI‑powered searches, Sonar stands poised to revolutionize how companies gather and analyze data. This innovation allows organizations not only to streamline their operations but also to enhance their decision‑making processes, making them more robust and data‑driven. A primary feature of the Sonar API is its tiered service offerings, which cater to diverse business needs. The Standard Sonar tier offers a cost‑effective solution, ideal for enterprises looking to implement basic AI search capabilities without substantial financial outlays. Conversely, the Sonar Pro tier is designed for businesses requiring more advanced functionalities, such as the ability to handle complex, multi‑step queries and access an expanded set of citations. This flexibility ensures that the Sonar API can meet the needs of a wide array of industries and use cases. Sonar's emphasis on real‑time web searches with verifiable citations adds a layer of accountability and accuracy that many competing AI models lack. This focus on transparency and reliability is particularly attractive to enterprises in highly regulated industries, such as finance and healthcare , where data accuracy and compliance are paramount. By offering detailed citations, Sonar enables businesses to trace search results back to their source, thereby bolstering trust and confidence in AI‑generated insights. With its launch, Perplexity 's Sonar API enters a competitive landscape dominated by established players like Google and OpenAI. However, Sonar distinguishes itself with unique enterprise‑focused features and a competitive pricing model that makes it appealing to both large corporations and smaller businesses. As such, Sonar's introduction to the market could challenge existing paradigms and spark further innovation in the realm of AI search technologies. Service Tiers: Standard Sonar and Sonar Pro The launch of Perplexity AI's Sonar API marks a significant stride in the integration of AI search technology into business applications. With two service tiers available, businesses have the flexibility to choose between the Standard Sonar and Sonar Pro options. The Standard Sonar tier offers a faster and more cost‑effective solution with essential features tailored for basic needs. Meanwhile, the Sonar Pro tier provides a premium experience, equipped with advanced capabilities such as handling multi‑step queries and offering expanded citation features, thereby catering to more complex enterprise requirements. Standard Sonar is an ideal choice for businesses looking to incorporate AI search capabilities without incurring high costs. It is designed to deliver fast and efficient search results, making it suitable for companies that need to manage their budgets judiciously. However, for those seeking a more robust solution, Sonar Pro stands out with its enhanced features. This tier supports complex multi‑step queries and provides larger context windows, which are essential for industries that rely on detailed and comprehensive data analysis. Moreover, Sonar Pro's offering of double citations compared to the standard tier enhances the reliability of results, and its compliance features are particularly beneficial for regulated industries such as finance and healthcare . Competitive Advantages of Sonar Perplexity AI's Sonar API offers competitive advantages that distinguish it from other AI search solutions. Primarily, Sonar emphasizes real‑time web searches capable of delivering verifiable results combined with robust enterprise‑specific features. This sets it apart from general‑purpose AI models like GPT‑4, which may not prioritize real‑time information accuracy to the same degree. One of the standout features of Sonar is its ability to generate verifiable citations, enhancing trust and credibility among enterprise users looking to substantiate their search results with authoritative sources. Sonar offers two distinct service tiers to accommodate varying levels of enterprise needs: the Standard Sonar and Sonar Pro. The Standard Sonar tier is optimized for cost‑effectiveness and speed, providing essential search functionalities at an accessible price point. Meanwhile, the Sonar Pro tier caters to enterprises requiring more advanced capabilities. This includes handling complex multi‑step queries, offering expanded context windows, and providing double the citations compared to the standard tier. Such features in Sonar Pro are particularly advantageous for industries with rigorous compliance and data accuracy demands, such as finance and healthcare , where maintaining precise and transparent search results is crucial. Industries across various sectors stand to benefit significantly from utilizing Sonar's advanced AI search capabilities. For example, banking and finance can leverage its functionalities for portfolio management through accurate data analysis, while healthcare sectors benefit from compliance reporting facilitated by real‑time information retrieval. Other sectors like manufacturing can enhance supply chain operations with rapid data access, and IT services can improve issue identification processes. Sales and marketing departments can also harness real‑time insights to target and engage audiences more effectively. Despite its advantages, organizations considering deploying Sonar must navigate several challenges. Data privacy remains a pressing concern due to Sonar's reliance on real‑time data collection. Companies must ensure they comply with regional privacy regulations and implement secure data practices. Additionally, organizations must assess the API's search accuracy to ensure it meets their specific needs and consider the level of customization required to integrate Sonar into existing systems. Finally, they must evaluate whether their current architecture can support Sonar and contend with competition from established tech giants offering similar solutions, such as Google's AI services. Industries Benefiting from Sonar Integration The financial sector, including banking and finance , stands to significantly benefit from the integration of Perplexity 's Sonar API. By leveraging its advanced AI search capabilities, financial institutions can enhance portfolio management through more efficient and accurate data gathering and analysis. This, in turn, can lead to better investment decisions, risk management , and compliance with regulatory requirements. The ability to handle complex multi‑step queries and the provision of real‑time data ensures that financial professionals have access to the freshest insights, which is crucial for dynamic market scenarios. In healthcare , Sonar's integration promises to streamline compliance reporting processes, a critical task for providers and insurers operating within stringent regulatory environments. The capability to manage larger context windows and offer expanded citations means that healthcare organizations can ensure more accurate and thorough documentation, reducing the risk of non‑compliance penalties. Additionally, the real‑time search function allows for quick access to the latest medical research and guidelines, aiding in better patient care and diagnosis. Manufacturers can harness Sonar's capabilities to optimize their supply chain operations. The API's ability to perform complex multi‑step queries can result in more efficient tracking and management of inventory, warehousing, and logistics functions. By staying updated with real‑time data, manufacturers can swiftly adapt to disruptions or changes in supply chain dynamics, enhancing operational resilience and efficiency. This technological edge supports just‑in‑time production models and minimizes waste, leading to cost savings. IT services companies are likely to adopt Sonar to bolster their issue identification and resolution processes. With Sonar's capability to access and process real‑time data, IT service providers can detect issues faster and with greater accuracy, enhancing their ability to deliver prompt and effective solutions to clients. Moreover, the potential for customizing search queries and having verifiable citations bolsters confidence in the AI‑driven resolutions, enabling these companies to maintain high quality service levels. Sales and marketing departments across various industries can leverage Sonar's AI search capabilities to identify market trends, competitor strategies, and consumer preferences more effectively. The enhanced data accuracy provided by Sonar enables these departments to fine -tune their strategies and campaigns, increasing engagement and conversion rates. Real‑time insights into market dynamics ensure that sales and marketing teams can remain agile, adapting their approaches in response to shifting consumer behaviors and emerging trends. Challenges in Implementing Sonar API Implementing the Sonar API in enterprises presents a myriad of challenges that must be addressed for successful integration. One major concern is data privacy, particularly given the API's reliance on real‑time web data. Companies must ensure that their use of the API complies with data protection regulations, which may require additional technical safeguards and compliance mechanisms. Another challenge is achieving the desired level of search accuracy. Enterprises need highly accurate search results to make informed decisions and drive business processes. This requires meticulous configuration and possibly the customization of the Sonar API to tailor it to the specific needs of the organization. Such customization necessitates a robust understanding of both the API’s functionalities and the organization's unique requirements. Architectural maturity is another prerequisite for successful implementation. Companies may need to evaluate and possibly enhance their existing IT infrastructure to support the integration of the Sonar API, ensuring that it can efficiently handle the demands of real‑time queries and data retrieval without compromising performance. There is also the matter of competition. Established players like Google have a strong foothold in the AI search market, and enterprises might hesitate to switch to a new provider like Perplexity 's Sonar API. Overcoming this inertia requires providing clear, demonstrable advantages in terms of performance, features, and cost‑effectiveness. Lastly, the need for integration with existing enterprise systems presents its own set of challenges. Seamlessly incorporating the Sonar API into current technology stacks can be complex and may involve significant development resources. It’s essential for enterprises to plan for these integration efforts and ensure they have the capabilities to address potential roadblocks in implementation. Related Industry Developments The launch of Perplexity AI's Sonar API marks a significant milestone in the AI search technology landscape. Unlike general AI models such as GPT‑4 that may not emphasize citation, Sonar's features are tailored to meet the high accuracy and compliance requirements of regulated industries. Additionally, enhanced compliance features make it a suitable choice for sectors like banking, finance , and healthcare , where regulatory adherence is critical. The potential impact of Sonar on various industries is substantial. These industries require robust search solutions that can handle complex queries while maintaining compliance with industry regulations. However, the adoption of Sonar is not without challenges. Organizations need to consider data privacy concerns, the accuracy of search results, customization needs, and architectural maturity before deciding to implement this technology. Additionally, the backdrop of competition from established AI search players like Google presents another layer of complexity as companies assess the risks and benefits of transitioning to a new search technology. The broader market landscape is also witnessing related developments, such as Google's launch of its Agentspace enterprise AI platform powered by the Gemini AI model, emphasizing advanced search capabilities, and Cognizant's renewed strategic partnership with McDonald's to transform enterprise systems with AI and cloud solutions. Perplexity is entering a competitive field, but its strategic positioning with the Sonar API has the potential to disrupt existing market dynamics, potentially triggering innovation and price adjustments across the sector. Expert Insights on Sonar API Launch In the ever‑evolving landscape of AI technology, Perplexity AI's introduction of the Sonar API marks a significant milestone. This innovative service allows businesses to seamlessly integrate AI search functionalities into their existing applications, thereby enhancing data retrieval and operational efficiency. The launch comes with two distinct service tiers: Standard Sonar, designed as a cost‑effective solution with essential features, and Sonar Pro, which offers advanced capabilities. These advanced features include support for multi‑step queries and enhanced citation options, which are especially beneficial for industries that require intensive data analysis and reporting. What sets Sonar apart from its competitors is its focus on real‑time web searches, coupled with verifiable citations. While many AI models, such as GPT‑4, are geared towards general applications, Sonar has been tailored specifically for enterprise use, offering a robust suite of features that cater to the distinct needs of industries like banking, healthcare , and IT services . For instance, in banking, its capabilities can aid in portfolio management, while in healthcare , it can streamline compliance reporting processes. The API’s focus on these real‑time, high‑accuracy search results makes it a compelling choice for businesses looking to enhance their data processing capabilities. Despite the promising potential of Sonar, organizations looking to implement this API face several challenges. These include concerns about data privacy and ensuring the accuracy of search results. Additionally, the requirement for a certain level of architectural maturity may pose a barrier for some enterprises. Furthermore, Sonar enters a competitive market dominated by established players such as Google, which can lead to concerns about differentiation and market positioning. Nonetheless, the API's competitive pricing strategy suggests a potential disruption in the current market dynamics, especially affecting smaller competitors who may struggle to maintain margins. The industry experts have varied opinions on the impact of Sonar's launch. Arun Chandrasekaran from Gartner acknowledges the leap Sonar presents in enabling real‑time web connectivity within AI searches while highlighting the inherent challenges this brings concerning enterprise deployment dependencies. Meanwhile, analysts like Sarah Hindlian‑Bowler from Macquarie Capital note the strategic pricing as a potential market disruptor. Nonetheless, the uncertainty regarding the transparency of Sonar's underlying LLM architecture remains a point of contention for experts like Dr. Alex Wong, who raises questions about reproducibility and bias mitigation. Public reaction to the Sonar API launch has been mixed. Many developers and tech enthusiasts express excitement over its real‑time search capabilities and competitive pricing . However, there are also notable concerns, such as skepticism about performance claims and potential privacy implications associated with real‑time data handling. Conversations on platforms like LinkedIn and Reddit reflect both the enthusiasm for the features offered by Sonar and the caution regarding its limitations, especially for smaller‑scale applications that might not fully utilize the basic tier's offerings. Looking ahead, the introduction of Sonar could have several profound implications. Its competitive pricing model could trigger a price war, leading to lower costs for AI search capabilities and potentially resulting in market consolidation. Furthermore, as AI search APIs like Sonar gain traction, we may see significant shifts in enterprise operations, particularly within regulated industries, as these tools enable more efficient compliance and decision‑making processes. There's also the potential for change in the workforce, with increased reliance on AI data processing emphasizing data interpretation roles over traditional information gathering tasks. Public and Community Reactions The launch of Perplexity 's Sonar API has sparked a varied response from both the tech community and broader public, with opinions ranging from enthusiastic support to cautious skepticism. The API's real‑time capabilities have impressed many developers who see it as a step forward in search accuracy, surpassing some of its competitors. Despite the excitement, there are concerns that need addressing. Developers are calling for more transparency in the API’s performance claims, urging Perplexity to publish detailed benchmarks to substantiate their claims and reassure potential users. Moreover, the debate on platforms like LinkedIn has raised questions about the limitations of the basic service tier, questioning whether it can deliver substantial performance in demanding environments. Privacy is another area where the Sonar API’s approach has led to unease, particularly regarding its real‑time data collection capabilities. Conversations on HackerNews and other tech‑focused platforms reflect a deep concern about how user data is managed and safeguarded, with many advocating for clearer privacy protocols and compliance with global data protection standards. Meanwhile, the developer community is actively engaging with the new API, offering feedback and sharing integration tips and code samples on GitHub. This proactive engagement underscores the interest and potential the API holds within tech circles, suggesting a vibrant ecosystem is already beginning to form around Perplexity ’s offering. Influential tech reviewers and thought leaders have provided largely positive feedback on Sonar’s ease of integration and practical applications, although they also note areas for future enhancement. Industry analysts predict that this move could lead to market consolidation, with smaller competitors being forced to rethink their strategies or face being outcompeted. Consequently, this could result in broader access to AI‑powered search solutions, fostering innovation and growth while also contributing to a more dynamic and competitive market landscape. Economic Impact and Market Dynamics The recent launch of Perplexity AI's Sonar API is poised to significantly alter the economic landscape and market dynamics within the enterprise AI search sector. The economic impact of Sonar is likely to be profound, with its competitive pricing strategy designed to disrupt existing market dynamics. title: Keuntungan Sewa Warehouse dengan Sistem WMS
summary: Sewa warehouse dengan sistem WMS meningkatkan efisiensi, akurasi, dan mengurangi biaya operasional untuk bisnis yang lebih berkembang.
body_text: Sewa warehouse yang dilengkapi dengan Warehouse Management System (WMS) memberikan keuntungan signifikan bagi perusahaan. Pengelolaan gudang yang cerdas dan terintegrasi membantu memaksimalkan ruang penyimpanan dan mempercepat proses logistik. Dengan berbagai manfaat yang ditawarkan, WMS menjadi solusi cerdas bagi bisnis yang berfokus pada pengelolaan inventaris yang lebih baik dan pengurangan biaya. Selain itu, WMS juga membantu dalam pengoptimalan alur kerja, meningkatkan efisiensi operasional secara keseluruhan. Dalam artikel ini, kita akan membahas berbagai keuntungan yang dapat diperoleh dengan menggunakan WMS. Serta bagaimana solusi ini berperan penting dalam meningkatkan kinerja bisnis. 1. Peningkatan Efisiensi Operasional Salah satu keuntungan utama dari penerapan WMS adalah peningkatan efisiensi operasional yang signifikan. WMS dapat meningkatkan efisiensi penyimpanan dan pengambilan barang hingga 50%. Hal ini tercapai karena WMS dapat mengoptimalkan tata letak dan kapasitas penyimpanan gudang, memungkinkan penggunaan ruang gudang secara maksimal. Hasilnya, perusahaan dapat mengurangi biaya operasional yang timbul akibat penggunaan ruang yang tidak efisien. Dengan ruang penyimpanan yang lebih terorganisir, waktu pengambilan barang menjadi lebih singkat. Hal ini mengurangi waktu idle dan meningkatkan produktivitas secara keseluruhan. 2. Akurasi Inventory yang Lebih Baik Akurasi inventory merupakan aspek yang sangat penting dalam pengelolaan gudang. WMS meningkatkan akurasi inventaris hingga 20% dengan memanfaatkan teknologi pelacakan real-time seperti barcode dan RFID. Sistem ini memungkinkan perusahaan untuk melacak barang dengan lebih tepat dan akurat. Peningkatan akurasi inventory mengurangi risiko kekurangan atau kelebihan stok, yang dapat menyebabkan kerugian finansial. Dengan mengetahui posisi barang secara akurat, perusahaan dapat merencanakan pengadaan dan pengiriman barang dengan lebih efisien. Ini akan menghindari kesalahan yang dapat berakibat pada ketidaksesuaian pasokan. 3. Pengurangan Biaya Operasional Implementasi WMS dapat mengurangi biaya operasional hingga 35%. Salah satu cara WMS mengurangi biaya adalah dengan mengurangi kebutuhan tenaga kerja manual yang diperlukan untuk memantau stok atau mengelola gudang. Selain itu, WMS juga meminimalkan kesalahan dalam pengelolaan stok, yang sering menyebabkan pemborosan dan kerugian. Dengan menggunakan WMS, perusahaan dapat memaksimalkan efisiensi operasional, sehingga mengurangi biaya penyimpanan dan distribusi barang. Ini juga membantu perusahaan untuk mempertahankan margin keuntungan yang lebih baik, meskipun terdapat pengeluaran yang lebih sedikit dalam proses logistik. 4. Peningkatan Kecepatan Proses WMS mempercepat proses pengambilan dan pengelolaan barang dengan sistematisasi alur kerja dan identifikasi lokasi otomatis. Dengan menggunakan WMS, staf gudang dapat dengan mudah menemukan lokasi barang yang diinginkan tanpa harus melakukan pencarian manual. Ini mempercepat waktu pengambilan barang, meningkatkan produktivitas karyawan , dan mempercepat proses pengiriman kepada pelanggan. Kecepatan dalam mengelola dan mengirim barang sangat penting untuk memenuhi kebutuhan pelanggan dan menjaga kepuasan mereka. Dengan WMS, perusahaan dapat memastikan pengiriman tepat waktu, yang berkontribusi pada keunggulan kompetitif di pasar. 5. Optimalisasi Supply Chain Sewa warehouse memberikan visibilitas yang lebih baik terhadap stok yang tersedia. Tentunya, memungkinkan perusahaan untuk merencanakan pengiriman dan penerimaan barang dengan lebih tepat waktu. Dengan pemantauan stok secara langsung, perusahaan dapat menghindari situasi darurat yang memerlukan pengiriman mendadak, yang sering mahal dan tidak efisien. WMS memungkinkan perusahaan merencanakan kebutuhan secara lebih terstruktur, yang sering mengurangi ketergantungan pada pengiriman mendadak. Hal ini juga membantu menghindari masalah stok yang tidak terkelola dengan baik. Hal ini membantu perusahaan dalam mempertahankan kelancaran rantai pasokan dan meningkatkan efisiensi logistik secara keseluruhan. 6. Manajemen Data yang Lebih Baik WMS tidak hanya membantu dalam pengelolaan stok barang, tetapi juga menyediakan analitik data secara real-time . Dengan data yang lebih baik dan terkini, perusahaan dapat membuat keputusan berbasis data yang lebih tepat. Sewa warehouse memungkinkan perusahaan untuk memprediksi kebutuhan stok, merencanakan strategi produksi, dan melakukan pengadaan barang dengan lebih efektif. Dengan kemampuan analitik yang kuat, perusahaan dapat mengoptimalkan strategi bisnis dan meningkatkan efisiensi keseluruhan, baik dalam hal produksi maupun distribusi. 7. Keamanan Gudang yang Ditingkatkan Keamanan menjadi salah satu prioritas dalam pengelolaan gudang . Dengan WMS, perusahaan dapat meningkatkan tingkat keamanan gudang melalui kontrol akses yang lebih ketat dan pelacakan pergerakan barang secara otomatis. Dengan sistem yang terintegrasi, risiko pencurian atau kerusakan barang dapat diminimalkan, karena setiap barang yang masuk atau keluar dari gudang dapat terlacak dengan jelas. WMS memberikan laporan yang akurat tentang pergerakan barang, sehingga perusahaan dapat memastikan barang tetap aman. Keuntungan yang ditawarkan WMS dalam sewa warehouse bagi bisnis sangat besar. Peningkatan efisiensi, akurasi, dan kecepatan proses operasional dapat memberikan dampak positif yang signifikan pada keuntungan perusahaan. Jika Anda ingin mengoptimalkan pengelolaan gudang dan meningkatkan kinerja logistik, pertimbangkan untuk menyewa warehouse yang dilengkapi dengan WMS. Shipper menyediakan layanan pergudangan dan fulfillment menyeluruh dengan sistem manajemen yang andal. Dengan SLA hingga 99.8%, operasional pergudangan kami didukung tim ahli yang berpengalaman. title: What to Know about How Long Does Waxing Last
summary: Want to maximize your waxing results? Understanding how to care for your skin between sessions is key! Learn how to extend the results of your wax today.
body_text: Waxing is one of the most popular ways to achieve a long-lasting smooth, and it’s no wonder why! Waxing removes hair from the root, leaving your skin hair-free for weeks and helping you cut back on daily shaving. At European Wax Center, we make the experience as quick, comfortable, and effective as possible with our signature Comfort Wax® and expertly trained Wax Specialists. Want to make the most of your waxing results? Understanding how to care for your skin between sessions is key! Keep reading to learn how to maximize and extend the results of your wax. Typical Timelines for Waxing Results How Long Does a Wax Take? Most waxing services at European Wax Center take 15-30 minutes, depending on the area. Whether you’re waxing your legs, arms, or eyebrows, our Wax Specialists are trained to deliver an efficient yet thorough service. How Long Does Waxing Last? On average, you’ll enjoy smooth skin for 2-3 weeks. Most guests re-book by week three or four, at which point the hair has grown out enough for another wax. The exact timing depends on factors like your hair growth rate and the area being waxed. For more visible areas like eyebrows, face, or underarms, some guests even prefer to schedule touch-ups every two weeks. We also offer an Unlimited Wax Pass ® , so you can book as often as you need for these frequent services while saving money. Hair Type and Growth Rate Everyone’s hair grows differently, but we recommend waxing when your hair reaches about ¼” in length (roughly the size of a grain of rice). Areas influenced by hormones, like the face and bikini line, tend to grow faster, so staying closer to the three-week mark may be best. Not sure how often to book? Your Wax Specialist can recommend a schedule tailored to your hair and skin type. Factors Affecting How Long Waxing Lasts Hair Growth Cycles When you first start waxing, it may take up to three sessions to get all your hair on the same growth cycle. After this, you’ll experience fewer stray hairs between waxes and longer-lasting smoothness. Consistency is key—sticking to a 3-4 week schedule ensures optimal results as your hair grows back thinner and softer over time. Skin Type and Hair Thickness No matter your skin type or hair texture, our Comfort Wax® is designed to work for everyone—even those with sensitive skin or coarse hair. Plus, every wax gets easier as your hair becomes finer with time. Consistency Unlike shaving, which cuts hair at the surface and leaves a blunt, stubbly end, waxing removes hair from the root. The more you wax, the softer and thinner your hair becomes, making the process easier and your results longer-lasting. However, shaving or plucking between waxes disrupts this process, so we recommend staying consistent with waxing to see the best benefits. Tips for Prolonging Waxing Results Post-Wax Care To maximize your waxing results, follow an In-Between Routine , a simple skincare regimen to keep your skin smooth, help reduce bumps, and prep for your next wax. Here’s what we recommend: Cleanse : Use a gentle cleanser to keep your skin clean and refreshed. Exfoliate : Exfoliate regularly to remove dead skin cells and help prevent ingrown hairs. Moisturize : Hydrate your skin to keep it smooth and nourished. Pro Tip: Try our EWC TREAT® Ingrown Hair Serum daily to help prevent bumps and breakouts. Products to Avoid Avoid harsh skincare products, heavy oils, and exfoliating acids like AHAs on freshly waxed areas since these can irritate your skin or clog pores. Extend Results with the Right Products Our EWC SLOW® line, featuring narcissus bulb extract, is designed to help visibly slow hair regrowth and reduce hair thickness between waxes. Pair it with our EWC TREAT® line for smooth, bump-free skin. Not sure what’s best for you? Ask your Wax Specialist for a personalized product recommendation. Keeping Skin Smooth Between Sessions Maintaining smooth, healthy skin between waxes is simple with EWC’s In-Between Routine, which includes three essential steps: cleansing, exfoliating, and moisturizing. This routine helps prevent irritation, bumps, and ingrown hairs, keeping your skin prepped and glowing for your next wax. Read more about The 3 Steps of Your In-Between Wax Routine . EWC-Recommended Products for Smooth Skin: EWC TREAT® Ingrown Hair Serum : Use daily to help prevent bumps, breakouts, and ingrown hairs. EWC SLOW® Collection : Formulated with narcissus bulb extract to soothe skin and help visibly reduce hair regrowth between waxing sessions. Not sure what products work best for your skin? Your Wax Specialist is also a product expert and can help you put together a personalized skincare routine tailored to your unique needs. Your Smoothest Skin Awaits Waxing is the ultimate solution for long-lasting smoothness, but keeping up with a regular schedule and caring for your skin between waxes makes all the difference. Stick to a 3-4 week routine, use the right products, and follow expert advice to enjoy the full benefits of waxing. Ready to experience the EWC difference? Book your next waxing reservation today and let our Wax Specialists help you achieve your smoothest, most confident self.

title: New Leadership Duo at HURCO: Shaping the Future Together
summary: Pliening, January 2 2025 HURCO is strengthening its leadership with a new management duo: Klaus Hölzl will join Michael Auer […]
body_text: 01.01.2025 New Leadership Duo at HURCO: Shaping the Future Together Pliening, January 2 2025 HURCO is strengthening its leadership with a new management duo: Klaus Hölzl will join Michael Auer as Co-Managing Director. Together, they aim to further enhance HURCO’s innovative strength and market position, with a particular focus on automation. Shared Leadership for Greater Success Michael Auer, previously the sole Managing Director, will now focus on strategic planning and corporate development. Klaus Hölzl, who has been HURCO’s Sales Director since 2014, will take charge of operations and sales. “I’m delighted to have Klaus Hölzl, a highly experienced and dedicated colleague, by my side,” said Auer. Driving Innovation With extensive expertise in sales and mechanical engineering, Klaus Hölzl is committed to strengthening HURCO’s position as a technology leader and increasing awareness of the Takumi brand. A key focus for him will be on automation solutions. “The demand for automation is growing, even in single-part and small-batch production. With our ProCobots systems and the integrated WinMax control, we offer tailored and cost-efficient solutions,” Hölzl emphasized. title: Interlink Electronics, Inc. Announces $150,000 SBIR R&D Award from NASA for the Development of Predictive Air Quality Assessment Solutions
summary: Interlink Electronics, Inc. Announces $150,000 SBIR R&D Award from NASA for the Development of Predictive Air Quality Assessment Solutions Recognizes Company's leading position in gas sensor research and commercialization IRVINE, Calif., Jan. 9, 2025 /PRNewswi
body_text: Interlink Electronics, Inc. Announces $150,000 SBIR R&D Award from NASA for the Development of Predictive Air Quality Assessment Solutions Recognizes Company's leading position in gas sensor research and commercialization IRVINE, Calif., Jan. 9, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Interlink Electronics, Inc. (NASDAQ: LINK), a world-leading provider of sensors and printed electronic solutions that support a wide range of applications, including Human-Machine Interface ("HMI") devices and IoT solutions, is pleased to announce that its Gas and Environmental Solutions division has received a $150,000 SBIR Phase 1 award from NASA for development of integrated systems and predictive models to assist in early identification of sources impacting air quality. As a result of climate change and other factors, it is becoming increasingly important to properly assess outdoor air quality and accurately pinpoint the sources causing any deterioration at a given time and be able to do so rapidly. In addition to enabling a healthier lifestyle for all, this is an essential public safety service that national, state and local governments world-wide are beginning to emphasize. "This award recognizes the fundamental building block technologies that Interlink has built over the years, and enables us to develop accurate, low-power, low-cost and widely deployable OAQ nodes that provide reliable, high- density AQ data for interfacing with NASA's Remote Sensing Network," said Dr. Sreeni Rao, Vice President of Product Management at Interlink Electronics. "Ultimately, we envision delivering a validated prototype solution that integrates gas sensor hardware with in-house developed compensation techniques and algorithms that enable seamless use of hyper-local real-time AQ data in models based on NASA satellite observations." "Our mission is to deliver high-performing cost-competitive sensing solutions incorporating Interlink's outstanding gas sensors with advanced software support," added Steven N. Bronson, Interlink's CEO and President. "This award continues our history of qualifying for SBIR grants, and we are also pleased to note that NASA recognized the superior scientific and engineering backgrounds and talents of the Interlink team." About Interlink Electronics, Inc. Interlink Electronics is a leading provider of sensors and printed electronic solutions, boasting 40 years of success in delivering mission-critical technologies across diverse markets. Our broad product and technology portfolio encompasses force, piezo-electric, rugged HMI, wearable sensors for textiles and fabrics, gas sensors, instruments, and systems. Our blue-chip customers trust our products and solutions which span various markets, including industrial, medical, automotive, consumer, wearables, and IoT. Our technical and engineering expertise in materials science, manufacturing, embedded electronics, firmware, and software enables us to create and deliver high-quality, cost-effective custom solutions tailored to our customers' unique requirements.
